feature-heading.purpose: Featured profiles (team member names) between section and card level.

title-minor.purpose: Dense interactive rows such as FAQ questions.

fine-print.purpose: Legal, disclaimers, NMLS lines, form labels (600 weight), breadcrumbs.

meta-label.purpose: Dates, category badges, role chips, stat captions.

stat-md.purpose: Supporting evidence numbers and timeline markers.

shadows.name: ambient-feature
shadows.purpose: Large inset advisor or contact compositions.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover with a restrained upward movement.

shadows.name: teal-action
shadows.purpose: Rare emphasized primary actions on dark feature surfaces.

motion.name: navigation

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-emphasis action in the PHX interface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--phx-accent, #1f6e8c); color: #fff; font: 600 14.5px/1.5 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.15); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--phx-accent-hover, #18576f); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that remains clear without competing with teal.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--phx-border, #e7e1d6); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); font: 600 14.5px/1.5 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(19, 28, 59, 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.3); background: var(--phx-cream-050, #fbf9f4); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Copper Button
components.description: A subordinate media or editorial action that adds warmth without competing with a primary teal action.
components.css: .ds-btn-copper { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--phx-copper-600, #b4552d); color: #fff; font: 600 14.5px/1.5 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -12px rgba(180, 85, 45, 0.7); transition: filter 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-copper:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-copper:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.55); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-copper:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A comfortable, clearly bounded field for contact and guidance flows.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); font-family: "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--phx-border-input, #d8d1c3); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--phx-cream-000, #fdfcf9); color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); font: 400 15px/1.4 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--phx-text-muted, #5b6172); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--phx-accent, #1f6e8c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.2); }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: The default evidence or educational card on a neutral section.
components.html:
HOME LOAN GUIDANCE

Clear options, explained personally.

Understand the tradeoffs before choosing your next step.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--phx-border, #e7e1d6); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-card-default, #fff); color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(19, 28, 59, 0.06); transition: box-shadow 200ms ease-out, transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 22px 48px rgba(19, 28, 59, 0.14); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--phx-accent, #1f6e8c); font: 600 12px/1 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); font: 600 24px/1.2 "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--phx-text-body, #3d4356); font: 400 16px/1.7 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: The default desktop navigation link and focus behavior.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); font: 500 14.5px/1 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--phx-accent, #1f6e8c); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { border-radius: 6px; outline: 3px solid rgba(31, 110, 140, 0.4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: A compact orientation cue; teal by default and copper only as secondary warmth.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-block; color: var(--phx-accent, #1f6e8c); font: 600 12px/1 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Neutral Surface Section
components.description: A canonical Page Builder section that receives white or cream from the shared resolver.
components.html:
LOCAL EXPERTISE

A clearer path through your home loan.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 80px 24px; background: var(--surface-section-cream, #f7f4ee); color: var(--phx-text-heading, #131c3b); } .ds-surface-inner { width: min(100%, 1280px); margin: 0 auto; } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--phx-accent, #1f6e8c); font: 600 12px/1 "Archivo", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-surface-title { max-width: 720px; margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(30px, 3vw, 36px)/1.25 "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-surface { padding-top: 96px; padding-bottom: 96px; } }

narrative.overview:
PHX Home Loan should feel like a knowledgeable local advisor sitting beside a customer: warm, personal, credible, clear, calm, and locally grounded. The system earns trust through legible explanations, real people, useful evidence, and confident next steps. It does not borrow authority from cold institutional banking or luxury-mortgage gloss.

The canonical implementation and shared tokens are the design authority. Prototypes in `PHXHomeLoan-web-prototype` express the intended composition and editorial direction, with one correction: their exported copper accents should usually be Advisor Teal. Legacy and template blocks are anti-reference; their generic colors, typography, and component language must not be propagated into new canonical work.
keyCharacteristics: Warm editorial typography paired with plainspoken interface copy
Advisor Teal actions against navy, paper, ivory, and white surfaces
Restrained Mesa Copper details that add warmth without competing with teal
Structured grids, generous reading space, and evidence-led compositions
Soft, precise geometry with restrained ambient depth
Full WCAG 2.2 AA behavior across states, themes, and viewport sizes

rules.name: The Teal Leads Rule
rules.body: Advisor Teal owns primary actions and active states. Mesa Copper may warm a composition and style subordinate media or editorial actions, but it must never create a second primary action hierarchy.

rules.name: The Explicit Neutral Surface Rule
rules.body: Page Builder sections that expose the Sanity background toggle use white by default and may be set to cream. Reordering sections must not change their surfaces. Sections with designed fixed backgrounds do not expose the toggle.

rules.name: The Editorial Clarity Rule
rules.body: Serif type establishes trust and hierarchy; Archivo carries every task, explanation, label, and action. Do not use the display face as decorative body copy.

rules.name: The Ambient, Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Depth should feel like soft environmental light. Use tonal separation and borders first; reserve stronger shadows for state, overlap, or high-value emphasis.

rules.name: The Softness Has Scale Rule
rules.body: Radius grows with the physical and visual size of the object. Do not apply one exaggerated radius to controls, cards, sections, and media indiscriminately.

dos: Do lead with Advisor Teal for actions, active states, links, and focus.
Do use Mesa Copper as restrained warmth in labels and secondary details.
Do honor each neutral section's explicit white or cream background setting.
Do use Source Serif 4 for editorial authority and Archivo for clarity and task completion.
Do build trust with real people, evidence, education, and verified claims.
Do meet WCAG 2.2 AA, including keyboard, focus, contrast, zoom, reduced motion, media, and responsive behavior.
donts: Don't copy the prototypes' exported copper default into primary actions; translate those accents to Advisor Teal unless the detail is intentionally secondary.
Don't propagate generic template colors, typography, or component treatments into canonical sections.
Don't treat migrated legacy sections as design-system authority.
Don't make the interface feel like generic SaaS, cold institutional banking, luxury-mortgage advertising, or Jimmy's national veteran-first brand.
Don't use strong shadows, pills, oversized radii, or motion as universal decoration.
Don't add the neutral background toggle to a section whose designed background should not be editor-controlled.
